title: Storage Surcharge on Lapsed Tire Orders — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Storage surcharge — lapsed Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty orders.** A storage surcharge is taken off the lapsed-order refund, charged per tire for every started week past hold, following the line and the time past hold:

| Order | Surcharge per tire per started week |
|---|---|
| a line whose new-tire (original) tread depth is at least 14/32 in (the Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty line, 14/32 in) | $2.00 |
| any other line, held more than 28 days past hold | $1.00 |
| any other order | none |

A started week is any part of a week: 1 to 7 days past hold is one started week, 8 to 14 days two, and so on. New-tire depths by line: 10, 10, 11, 14, 11, 11 (32nds of an inch).

**Cases (hypothetical 4-tire orders):** a 65K-line order 9 days past hold — 2 started weeks, $16.00; a 60K-line order 30 days past hold — 5 started weeks, $20.00; a 60K-line order 28 days past hold — none.
